narrative: Presents the structural mechanism behind emergence: at each level of reality, stable combinations become the vocabulary for the next level up, so that 'more is different' because sentences crystallize into words. Three frameworks — Koestler's holons, Whitehead's societies of actual occasions, and Walker's assembly theory — are shown to be converging descriptions of the same hierarchical architecture from physics, philosophy, and biology respectively.
